verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a file-based static site generator; edits are made directly to Markdown/MDX files and built as a whole via `npm run build`, but there is no documented feature for bulk operations across many discrete items (e.g., batch editing, bulk API updates, mass content operations) beyond a single versioning command that snapshots the whole docs folder. Missing for 10: any CLI/API for programmatic bulk edit/delete/update across many docs items, evidence of scripted mass operations, or automation-oriented bulk tooling.
